channel.description: Practical advice for your next application.

item.title: How to Write Achievement Bullet Points (With Before and After Examples)
item.description: Turn 'Responsible for…' into bullet points that show results. A simple formula, examples by role, and what to do if you don't have numbers.

item.title: How to Write a Cover Letter That Gets Read
item.description: A simple 4-part structure for a one-page cover letter, with an example opening and closing, and the mistakes that make recruiters stop reading.

item.title: How to Write a CV for Saudi Arabia Jobs
item.description: Common CV expectations for jobs in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam: format, personal details, keywords and job profiles, with a pre-application checklist.

item.title: How to Write a CV for UAE Jobs
item.description: What UAE recruiters commonly look for in a CV: format, personal details, keywords and length, plus a checklist before you apply in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah.

item.title: How to Write a CV Summary That Doesn't Sound Like Everyone Else's
item.description: 'Hardworking and motivated' tells a recruiter nothing. Here's a 3-line structure for a professional summary, with examples you can adapt.

item.title: CV vs Resume: What's the Difference in the US, UK and the Gulf?
item.description: The words 'CV' and 'resume' mean different things in different countries. Here's how expectations usually differ across the US, UK and Gulf, and how to adapt.

item.title: Europass CV: When You Need It and When You Don't
item.description: Europass is the EU's standard CV format. Here's when employers and programmes expect it, when a regular CV is better, and how to make a Europass CV stand out.

item.title: LinkedIn Headline Examples That Recruiters Actually Search For
item.description: Your LinkedIn headline is one of the most visible parts of your profile. Here's a simple formula and examples by role and career stage.

item.title: One Column or Two? Choosing the Right CV Layout
item.description: Two-column CVs look modern, but they can cause problems with hiring software and skim-reading recruiters. Here's when to use each layout.

item.title: What Is an ATS CV? And How to Check If Yours Works
item.description: An ATS CV is formatted so hiring software can read it and written so a recruiter keeps reading. Here's what that means and how to check your own CV in 10 minutes.
